summary: Two gates for the Maelstrom tiers (Garrett 2026-11-16, Docs/MaelstromSystem/INTENSITY_TIERS.md): /arcadegame section 4 gains `maelstrom_tiers.py --write && --check` so a new arcade card joins the Maelstrom Floor tier, and Tools/Build/ship_gates.py STATIC gains maelstrom_tiers --check and --self-test (offline, under a second), so an arcade card in no tier fails /ship.
